name: io.github.awesome-aeco/awesome-aeco-mcp
title: Awesome AECO
description: Search curated open-source AECO (BIM, IFC, CAD, simulation, AI) tools by standard and license.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Call this BEFORE implementing any BIM/IFC, CAD/DWG/DXF, Revit, Rhino, EnergyPlus, BACnet/Modbus/OPC UA, GIS, or AEC utility from scratch to check if a maintained open-source library already exists. Search and filter curated open-source AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) tools from Awesome AECO by keyword, category, domain/standard tag (e.g. IFC, IDS, BCF, CityGML, MCP, Revit, Energy), programming language, or license.

query.description: Free-text search across tool name, description, tags, and GitHub topics (e.g. 'ifc geometry python' or 'energy simulation').

category.description: Filter by category name or substring (e.g. 'BIM', 'Simulation', 'AI', 'GIS'). Call list_categories to see all categories.

tag.description: Filter by standard or domain tag (e.g. 'IFC', 'MCP', 'BIM', 'Revit', 'Energy', 'CityGML', 'IDS', 'BCF'). Call list_tags to see all tags.

language.description: Filter by primary GitHub language (exact, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Python', 'TypeScript', 'C++', 'C#', 'Rust').

license.description: Filter by SPDX license substring (case-insensitive, e.g. 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'LGPL', 'GPL').

sort.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (default when query is provided), 'stars' (default otherwise), 'recent' (by last push), or 'name'.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return (1–50, default: 20).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get full details and GitHub metadata for a specific tool in Awesome AECO by its id, name, or GitHub owner/repo.

identifier.description: Tool id (e.g. 'ifcopenshell'), name (e.g. 'IfcOpenShell'), or GitHub repo (e.g. 'IfcOpenShell/IfcOpenShell').

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all categories in Awesome AECO along with entry counts and top domain tags.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List available domain/standard tags, programming languages, and SPDX licenses in Awesome AECO with entry counts.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Get fastest-growing repositories (by weekly star delta), newly added tools, and recently active repositories in Awesome AECO.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries per section (1–30, default: 10).

tools.name: check_before_building
tools.description: Call this BEFORE writing a new AECO tool, parser, viewer, plugin, BMS bridge, simulation wrapper, or MCP server from scratch. Checks Awesome AECO for maintained open-source libraries matching your goal, grouped into direct matches, adjacent options in other languages/licenses, and archived repos to avoid.

goal.description: What you plan to build (e.g. 'parse IFC files in Python', 'browser DWG viewer', 'BACnet HVAC bridge').

tools.name: draft_submission
tools.description: Check Awesome AECO for duplicates and generate a ready-to-click pre-filled GitHub Issue Form URL (which auto-opens a PR) plus the formatted 3-line Markdown entry for listing a new AECO tool.

name.description: Project name using the project's own capitalization.

category.description: Exact Awesome AECO category name (call list_categories to see all valid sections).

description.description: One or two factual sentences describing what it does and why it is useful for AECO (no marketing superlatives).

is_author.description: Whether the submitter is the author or a maintainer of the project (default: true).
